# Billy

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

- **Family:** [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, and stolid twenty-year-old youth. He is characterized by a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is a twenty-year-old youth who possesses a stolid temperament and a round, expressionless face. He suffers from a notable lack of conversational ability.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- painful lack of conversational gifts  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for Anne's recital. After Anne's successful performance, Billy drove the three girls back home while they discussed the event.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

Billy is the brother of [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). The two travel together alongside their friends, such as when Billy drives [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from Anne's recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
